text: In 1964, company founders Hermann and Dr. Ernst Mahle transferred 99.9 percent of their ownership of the company to the MAHLE Foundation and 0.1 percent to MABEG, which holds the voting rights.
short: MAHLE has been 99.9% owned by the MAHLE Foundation since 1964.

source.name: MAHLE Group: MAHLE Foundation
source.quote: transferred 99.9 percent of their ownership of the Company to the MAHLE Foundation
